name: snookerkhelo
description: SnookerKhelo: snooker / pool parlour management system (MERN): table timers, billing, UPI QR, players, tournaments, reports

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
